description: analogWrite on PB0 (OC0A), PB1 (OC1A) and PB4 (OC1B) of the ATtiny85, analogWrite 0/255 as digital levels and digitalWrite ending PWM.
basis: ATTinyCore 1.5.2 wiring_analog.c with digital_pin_to_timer_PGM of tinyX5 (0: TIMER0A, 1: TIMER1A with TIMER1_PWM, 4: TIMER1B): analogWrite(0) and analogWrite(255) are digitalWrite(LOW/HIGH), other values set OCR0A, OCR1A, OCR1B; timer 0 in 8-bit fast PWM, timer 1 in PWM mode with OCR1C = 255, so the duty cycle equals the value; digitalWrite on a PWM pin turns PWM off (turnOffPWM)
